# Fathom Fibers v0.2.0-rc1

First public release candidate of the Fathom Fibers scientific desktop workspace.

## Highlights

- PySide6 dataset workspace with calibrated Zeiss SEM handling.
- Portable native builds for Linux x86_64, Windows x86_64, macOS Apple Silicon and macOS Intel.
- Python SIMPoly source-compatible estimator with documented validation limits.
- Fathom Local and experimental Fathom Field estimator family.
- Experimental Oriented Ribbon V1 refined-centerline infrastructure.
- Weighted diameter distributions, ECDFs and pairwise method-comparison metrics.
- Manual 5×5 human-reference workflow with per-measurement autosave.
- Image- and dataset-level scientific HTML reports.
- CSV / JSON / figure / HTML analysis-bundle export with provenance.
- Built-in Quick Start, user guide, methods guide and keyboard shortcuts.

## Scientific status

Fathom Field and Oriented Ribbon V1 are experimental. Python SIMPoly is a source-compatible approximation and exact MATLAB parity is not claimed. Real SEM comparisons characterize method behavior and agreement; they do not establish known absolute accuracy or ground truth.

Automatic measurements enter as `PROPOSED` and should be reviewed before they contribute to primary reported statistics.

## Downloads

Choose the archive matching your operating system and architecture. Every release archive has a matching `.sha256` sidecar for integrity verification.
